sourceProducts.title: 2026 Rising Stars Set - NBA Topps NOW® - 22 Card Set - PR: 7287
lines: 2026 Rising Stars Set - NBA Topps NOW® - 22 Card Set - PR: 7287
(1) Parallel or Autograph Redemption per set!
22-card complete set - featuring the 21 selected 2026 Castrol Rising Stars PLUS (1) of the following cards guaranteed:
Redemption for autographed base card parallel /5 or lower

The future stars of the NBA have arrived – and with them, the official 2026 NBA Topps Now Rising Stars set! Included in this 22-card set are the 2026 Castrol Rising Stars selections, featuring ten top rookies and 11 talented sophomores, and one (1) of the following cards guaranteed: Exclusive Rising Stars Parallel, numbered base card parallel, redemption for autographed base card parallel.
sourceProducts.qualification: Normalized factual text from fresh official product UI, not a raw HTML hash. Bundle PR7287 and 22-card configuration do not assign per-card print runs. Five base foil terms stay separate from the qualified autograph /5-or-lower statement. Rising Stars Parallel has no published numbering status in the reviewed source.
